claim: A claimant's burden of proof under Florida's private-sector whistleblower provisions, sections 448.101-105, Florida Statutes, requires proof of an actual violation of law, as opposed to a reasonable, good faith belief of a violation.
initial_reasoning: 95 So. 3d 106 (Florida Supreme Court) held that the burden of proof under Florida’s private‑sector whistleblower statute (sections 448.101‑105) requires the claimant to prove an actual violation of law, not merely a reasonable, good‑faith belief.
